desc: The Sur-Ron Ultra Bee MX 2025 is the do-it-all mid-weight electric dirt bike, delivering 11kW peak power, around 55mph and up to 50 miles of range. A favourite step-up for adult riders who have outgrown the Light Bee X.
name: Ultra Bee MX 2025

desc: The Sur-Ron Light Bee X (LBX) is the UK's best-selling electric dirt bike. 6kW peak power, ~45mph, 47-mile range. Lightweight, agile and endlessly upgradeable — perfect for trails, pit-bike racing and backyard riding. Also sold as the Sur-Ron Light Bee X 2026. The LBX is compatible with 60V and 72V upgrade batteries from eWatt, DHS and Chi Battery Systems.
name: Light Bee X (LBX)

desc: The Sur-Ron Light Bee L1e is the road-legal version of the legendary Light Bee, type-approved for UK roads. Restricted to 28mph, it needs L-plates, insurance and a CBT, making it ideal for 16+ riders. The road-legal Sur-Ron L1e — sometimes called the Surron road legal or Sur-Ron L1e — qualifies as a moped-class vehicle. Surron road legal riders need a CBT, insurance and road-legal tyres.
name: Light Bee L1e – Road Legal

desc: The Sur-Ron Storm Bee is a full-size electric motocross machine and a genuine 1:1 replacement for a 250-350cc petrol bike, with 21.5kW peak power, around 68mph and up to 60 miles of range.
name: Storm Bee

desc: The Sur-Ron Hyper Bee is the brand's youth pit-bike on 14in/12in wheels. Sur-Ron build quality and agile ride feel for younger and smaller riders. Speed-limited and off-road ready. Also known as the mini Sur-Ron or junior Sur-Ron — the Hyper Bee is the lightest Sur-Ron model, designed for younger and lighter riders who want genuine Sur-Ron quality.
name: Hyper Bee 2025

desc: The Talaria Sting R MX4 is a popular adult off-road electric dirt bike with 8kW peak power, around 53mph and roughly 53 miles of range. Gear-drive delivery and a tough chassis make it a strong Sur-Ron rival.
name: Sting R MX4 – Off Road

desc: The Talaria Sting L1e is the road-legal Sting, type-approved for UK roads at 28mph. It adds lights, indicators, mirrors and a number plate holder so 16+ riders can ride legally with a CBT.
name: Sting L1e – Road Legal

desc: The Talaria Sting MX5 Pro steps up to a 72V 40Ah battery for a substantial power and range boost over 60V models. Talaria's most potent Sting, built for demanding off-road riding. Also known as the Talaria Sting Pro or Talaria Sting R Pro — the MX5 Pro is the 72V flagship of the Sting range.
name: Sting MX5 Pro – 72V

desc: The Talaria X3 (also known as the XXX) features a distinctive frame-spanning 60V battery design and a lightweight chassis, offering precise handling for off-road adventures.
name: X3 (XXX)

desc: The Talaria Komodo TL6000 is a high-power electric dirt bike with 22kW peak power, around 66mph and up to 70 miles of range — Talaria's answer to high-end electric performance bikes.
name: Komodo TL6000

desc: The Stark Varg MX 1.2 is the world's most powerful electric motocross bike: up to 80HP, 7.2kWh battery, KYB suspension and a lighter chassis with around 20% more range than the previous generation.
name: Varg MX 1.2

desc: The Stark Varg EX is the road-legal version of the Varg, adding UK road approval and an 18in rear wheel for enduro use, with up to 80HP of fully adjustable electric power.
name: Varg EX – Road Legal

desc: The KTM SX-E 5 is an advanced all-electric youth motocross bike with 5kW peak power, a 907Wh battery and fully adjustable WP Xact suspension. A genuine READY TO RACE platform for junior racers.
name: SX-E 5

desc: The KTM SX-E 3 is the ideal electric mini-crosser for thrill-seeking juniors, with a 3.8kW motor, 648Wh battery and six ride modes — the perfect step up from a balance bike.
name: SX-E 3

desc: The KTM SX-E 2 bridges the gap between a balance bike and the SX-E 3. On 10in wheels with adjustable ergonomics, it is the ideal first electric motorcycle for the youngest riders.
name: SX-E 2

desc: The E Ride Pro SS 2.0 is a high-value 72V electric dirt bike with 12kW peak power and around 56mph. It sits between the Sur-Ron and Stark Varg price brackets for riders wanting more power affordably.
name: SS 2.0 (19in) – 72V 12kW

desc: The E Ride Pro S is the 17in, 72V 6kW model in the E Ride Pro range — a more compact, accessible off-road electric dirt bike with strong value.
name: S (17in) – 72V 6kW

desc: The RFN Ares Rally is an award-winning adult off-road electric dirt bike with a 5kW motor, long range and 200mm of suspension travel. Its convertible design adapts from enduro to trail riding tool-free.
name: Ares Rally

desc: The RFN Ares Rally Pro is the race-focused version of the Ares Rally, with a 72V 12.5kW system and top-tier components built for competition and extreme off-road performance.
name: Ares Rally Pro

desc: The RFN Ares RS Endurance is the road-legal L1e model in the Ares range, with a 74V 4kW system designed for comfortable daily commuting with light off-road capability.
name: Ares RS Endurance (L1e)

desc: The RFN Warrior Youth SX-E5 is a kids' electric dirt bike for ages 6–10. A balanced mix of power and control with KTM SX-E styling to build young riders' confidence off-road.
name: Warrior Youth SX-E5

desc: The RFN Warrior Youth SX-E8 is a youth electric dirt bike for older kids, with more performance than the SX-E5 while keeping RFN's core safety technology.
name: Warrior Youth SX-E8

desc: The Revvi 12in is the UK's best-selling kids' electric balance bike. At just 9kg with two speed settings, it helps children aged 2–6 learn balance and progress to throttle control with confidence.
name: Revvi 12in Kids Electric Balance Bike

desc: The Revvi 16in is a kids' electric balance bike for ages 4–6. 250W motor, three speed settings and larger 16in wheels for a wider variety of terrain. Steps up naturally from the Revvi 12in.
name: Revvi 16in Kids Electric Balance Bike

desc: The Revvi 16in Plus adds front suspension forks, knobbly tyres and alloy rims to the popular 16in model, giving young riders genuine off-road capability on dirt tracks and pump tracks.
name: Revvi 16in Plus Kids Electric Balance Bike

desc: The Revvi 18in is a popular step-up electric dirt bike for kids aged 8-12, reaching up to 20mph with hydraulic disc brakes and a lightweight aluminium frame.
name: Revvi 18in Kids Electric Bike

desc: The Revvi 20in is the top of the Revvi range for riders aged 10+, with an 800W motor, three speeds up to 22mph and full suspension for a genuine mini dirt bike experience.
name: Revvi 20in Kids Electric Bike

desc: The FunBikes MX350 is a 350W, 36V kids' electric dirt bike with a lithium battery. An affordable, fun entry point for younger off-road riders aged 5–9.
name: MX350 350W Kids Electric Dirt Bike

desc: The FunBikes MXR 790W is a kids' electric dirt bike for ages 6–10. Up to 15mph with an adjustable speed limiter, sturdy frame and lightweight build. A confident first off-road bike.
name: MXR 790W – Ages 6–10

desc: The FunBikes MXR 1400W is a kids' electric dirt bike for ages 10–14. 1400W motor, up to 20mph with an adjustable speed limiter — more power as young riders build confidence.
name: MXR 1400W – Ages 10–14

desc: The FunBikes MXR 1800W is the most powerful bike in the MXR range, with 1800W, up to 25mph and a lithium battery — built for older, more confident young riders.
name: MXR 1800W 2025

desc: The Razor MX350 Dirt Rocket is a well-known, affordable kids' electric dirt bike. Up to 14mph, steel frame and authentic MX styling — a trusted first electric bike for ages 7+.
name: MX350 Dirt Rocket

desc: The Razor MX400 Dirt Rocket is a step up from the MX350 — a slightly larger kids' electric dirt bike with a steel frame, 14mph top speed and authentic off-road design for ages 7+.
name: MX400 Dirt Rocket

desc: The KTM Freeride E is the first road-legal KTM electric enduro bike, rebuilt from the ground up with an in-house motor, chromoly steel frame, WP XPLOR suspension and 5.5kWh battery. Hot-swap capable, three ride modes, 59mph top speed.
name: Freeride E 2025

desc: The Zero XB is a road-legal lightweight electric dirt bike with CBT-accessible A1 category type approval. 9.8bhp, 2.4kWh battery, 47-mile range and off-road CST tyres — ideal for younger riders and commuters wanting trail capability. As an L1e type-approved electric bike, the Zero XB sits in the same licence category as a 125 electric bike — CBT or full licence required, no A1 or A2 needed.
name: XB 2026

desc: The Zero XE is Zero's flagship electric dirt bike — 21bhp, 4.3kWh battery, 65-mile range on a 21/18in wheel setup with fully adjustable KKE suspension. Road legal (A1), serious off-road capability, 53mph top speed.
name: XE 2026

desc: The Stark Varg SM is the supermoto variant of the world's most powerful electric motocross bike — same 80HP motor and 7.2kWh battery, now on 17in supermoto wheels with road-biased tyres for track days and road use.
name: Varg SM

desc: The Talaria Dragon is Talaria's full-power adult electric dirt bike — aggressive MX-inspired design, high-torque motor and long-range battery built for serious off-road riders who want more than a trail bike.
name: Dragon

desc: The Talaria Sting MX3 is the entry-level Sting — 60V 38Ah battery, 6kW peak power and full off-road suspension. The perfect introduction to the Talaria range at a competitive price point. The Talaria Sting MX3 uses the same proven frame as the MX4 (Sting R) — the MX3 and MX4 designations refer to the battery generation, not a different chassis.
name: Sting MX3

desc: The Talaria Sting XXX is the crossover model — combining the Sting's proven frame with a unique battery configuration designed for maximum aftermarket upgrade potential. Popular with performance-oriented riders. Also known as the Talaria Triple X or Talaria XXX Pro — the Sting XXX is the upgrade-focused model in the Talaria range.
name: Sting XXX

desc: The Talaria X3 Pro is the upgraded variant of the X3 (XXX) — enhanced suspension components, improved brake system and higher-spec finishing for riders wanting the X3 platform with factory-level refinement.
name: X3 Pro

desc: The GasGas MC-E 2 2025 is the entry-level electric motocross bike from the KTM group — built on KTM SX-E underpinnings with distinctive GasGas Red livery. Designed for young riders stepping up to competitive MX. Also listed as the Gas Gas MC-E 2 — the GasGas and Gas Gas spellings are used interchangeably for this model.
name: MC-E 2 2025

desc: The GasGas MC-E 5 2025 is the full-size youth/junior electric motocross bike — same KTM SX-E 5 platform with GasGas Red livery, WP suspension and competition-spec geometry for riders aged 12 and up. Also listed as the Gas Gas MC-E 5 — built on the same platform as the KTM SX-E 5 with GasGas Red livery.
name: MC-E 5 2025

desc: The E Ride Pro SR is the flagship full-size model in the E Ride Pro range — 72V 50Ah battery, 12kW peak power, 19in front wheel and aggressive off-road geometry. The most capable E Ride Pro built.
name: SR (19in) – 72V 12kW

desc: The Razor MX125 is a compact electric dirt bike for younger children aged 6 and up — smaller frame than the MX350, lightweight steel construction and speed-limited to keep early riders safe and confident.
name: MX125 Dirt Rocket

desc: The Razor MX650 Dirt Rocket is the largest and most powerful Razor electric dirt bike — 36V battery, up to 17mph, steel frame and chain-drive for riders aged 16 and up. A big step up from the MX400.
name: MX650 Dirt Rocket

desc: The Segway Xaber 300 is a compact electric quad/ATV from Segway Powersports — intelligent IOV connectivity, responsive handling and durable build for recreational off-road riding. Ideal for younger adult riders.
name: Xaber 300

desc: The Segway Xafari is a lifestyle electric ATV built for adventure — rugged off-road capability combined with Segway's smart IOV system. Comfortable enough for trail riding, capable enough for demanding terrain.
name: Xafari

desc: The Segway Xyber is the performance electric ATV in the Segway Powersports range — higher power output, sport-tuned suspension and aggressive styling for riders who want maximum performance from an electric quad.
name: Xyber

desc: The STACYC 12eDRIVE is a balance bike for children aged 2–5 — ultra-lightweight, electric-assist throttle and two speed settings help young riders build confidence and progress naturally to pedal bikes.
name: 12eDRIVE

desc: The STACYC 16eDRIVE Brushless is the upgraded version for children aged 4–7 — brushless motor for smoother power delivery, three speed settings and larger 16in wheels for growing riders stepping up from the 12.
name: 16eDRIVE Brushless

desc: The STACYC 18eDRIVE is designed for children aged 5–9 — 18in wheels, brushless motor, three speed settings and compatible with standard power tool batteries from DeWalt, Milwaukee and Makita for convenient charging.
name: 18eDRIVE

desc: The STACYC 20eDRIVE is the largest STACYC model for children aged 6–10 — 20in wheels, brushless motor and three adjustable speed settings. Bridges the gap between balance bikes and full electric dirt bikes perfectly.
name: 20eDRIVE
